item.description: Good morning, Sydney! It’s Friday, May 1st, 2026, and a gorgeous start to your long weekend here on the Daily Drive. We're looking at clear skies and a comfortable 22 degrees as we head into this May Day public holiday, perfect for whatever adventures you have planned! Did you know, May Day has ancient roots celebrating spring and fertility, but in Australia, it aligns with Labour Day in some states – a double reason to enjoy your day off! So, let's hit the road and make it a fantastic Friday!
